innovation.summary: Seeed introduces an innovative approach to password management by generating and regenerating passwords using a unique 'seed' and a master password, addressing the common issue of password forgetfulness. It allows users to easily recover passwords and customize their generated passwords with symbols and capital letters, enhancing usability and security.
